title: fix(desktop): screenshot shortcut during a take notifies instead of toasting a hidden window (audit SHOT-B7)
body:
## What changed and why

Closes audit finding **SHOT-B7**. During a recording the hub hides the main window, so pressing the screenshot shortcut (⌘⌃X) made the renderer show its "finish the recording first" toast inside a hidden window: the user saw nothing.

- New pure `routeCaptureRequest` in `main/screenshots/capture-request.ts`: when `hub.isActive()` it calls `notifyBusy()` and never forwards; otherwise it calls `forwardToRenderer()`.
- `triggerCaptureScreenshot` in `main/index.ts` uses it. Busy → macOS `Notification` (same approach as the existing already-recording notice). The refusal returns before `createWindow(false)`, so a closed window is not recreated just to refuse. Every capture entry point (the four shortcuts and the panel's "Capture Screen") goes through this function.
- New i18n key `dialogs.captureWhileRecordingTitle` in `en` and `es`; the body reuses `screenshots.captureWhileRecording`.
- The renderer guard stays as the fallback for the countdown phase (hub not yet active, window still visible).

Limitation (same as the existing notice): if macOS notification permission is denied, the feedback is silent. Repeated presses stack banners; no throttling.

The plan file (`plans/audit-2026-10-15/36-screenshot-toast-window.md`) and its `00-index.md` row live on `docs/code-audit-2026-10-15` (PR #301), not on `main`, so there is nothing to delete here. Whoever lands #301 should drop that row.

## How I verified it

- Failing test first: `node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/main/screenshots/capture-request.test.ts` failed (module missing), then passed.
- `bun run verify` from the repo root, twice in a row: exit 0 both times (265 test files, 2296 tests in the desktop app, i18n parity included). The second run was served entirely from the Turbo cache.
- Not run: the manual steps below (they need a real recording on macOS) and the Playwright desktop E2E suite (CI runs it).

## How to test it yourself

1. Start a recording; press ⌘⌃X → a macOS notification "Finish the recording first" appears, no region selector opens, the recording continues.
2. Stop the recording; press ⌘⌃X → the normal capture works.
3. Press Record and, during the 3-2-1 countdown, press ⌘⌃X → the in-window toast appears (fallback path).

Refs NIW2-410

Run: Gas City session ni-wisp-ssjd3rv, bead ka-t5u, Mac mini
